body.name: Cellwise Layer-2.5 translation of an ordinary full kernel
body.construction: Translate the complete ordinary kernel \(Q[S_0]\) cell by cell into the finite batch \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{batch}}(S_0)\): the cell indexed by \((x,s)\) is the unnested one-world event \(Q_{x,s}=P((S_0)_x=s)\).  Translate every ordinary input kernel \(Q[V\setminus B](\cdot;b)\) into the labelled slice law \(P_b(V\setminus B)\).  The translation introduces no cross-world variable and never treats the batch as one scalar query.
